If the product mandate is 'every card CLICKABLE opening a standardized Deep-Dive modal', these ~120 cards need to be wired to RiskDetailModal with per-card AI recommendations.

rca_of_the_issue: Not a single bug — task is an audit sweep. Root cause of the gap: task-listed dynamic deep-dive wirings (discovered-*, owasp-*, sr-exposure-*, sg-month-card, benchmark-card-*, cyber-stat-mitigation/openrisks) were correctly implemented, but the platform-wide mandate 'every card CLICKABLE opening deep-dive' has NOT been applied to the KPI/summary cards on Overview, Risk Register, Decisions, Controls, Compliance, Vendors, Snapshot, Situation-Room KPIs, most AI-Governance summary tiles, FAIR-AIR vectors on Cyber-Risk, and 3 of 6 Benchmark cards. Backend endpoints supporting those deep-dives (risk-engine, connectors/health, PDFs) are all functional — this is purely a frontend onClick / modal-wiring surface to fill in.
